subject_schedules_validity_chk.name: subject_schedules_validity_chk
subject_schedules_validity_chk.value: "app"."subject_schedules"."valid_from" is null or "app"."subject_schedules"."valid_until" is null or "app"."subject_schedules"."valid_until" >= "app"."subject_schedules"."valid_from"

subjects_mode_fields_chk.name: subjects_mode_fields_chk
subjects_mode_fields_chk.value:
coalesce(case "app"."subjects"."counting_mode"
        when 'class_count' then "app"."subjects"."total_classes" > 0
        when 'workload' then "app"."subjects"."workload_hours" > 0 and "app"."subjects"."workload_hour_minutes" in (45, 50, 60)
                             and "app"."subjects"."unit_minutes" between 10 and 240
        when 'manual' then "app"."subjects"."manual_max_units" >= 0
      end, false)

attendance_logs_status_units_chk.name: attendance_logs_status_units_chk
attendance_logs_status_units_chk.value:
("app"."attendance_logs"."status" = 'present' and "app"."attendance_logs"."units_missed" = 0)
       or ("app"."attendance_logs"."status" = 'absent' and "app"."attendance_logs"."units_missed" = "app"."attendance_logs"."units_scheduled")
       or ("app"."attendance_logs"."status" = 'partial' and "app"."attendance_logs"."units_missed" between 1 and "app"."attendance_logs"."units_scheduled" - 1)
       or ("app"."attendance_logs"."status" = 'cancelled' and "app"."attendance_logs"."units_missed" = 0 and not "app"."attendance_logs"."is_excused")

notification_logs_threshold_chk.name: notification_logs_threshold_chk
notification_logs_threshold_chk.value: "app"."notification_logs"."kind" <> 'threshold' or coalesce("app"."notification_logs"."threshold_pct" in (50, 75, 90, 100) and "app"."notification_logs"."cycle" >= 1 and "app"."notification_logs"."subject_id" is not null, false)
